summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for agent-first token hub on FARTCOIN/BONK, including one real manual run, archive-English integrity checks, mobile overflow checks, settings-only financial controls validation, and route/state verification.

ui_bugs.issue: Community panel shows backend Not Found error instead of post list/empty state because frontend calls /api/posts?token=...

integration_issues.issue: HubOverview uses /posts?token={mint}; backend supports /tokens/{mint}/posts. This produces 404 and user-visible 'Not Found' in Community terminal.

action_items: Fix frontend community API path in HubOverview from `/posts?token=${token.address}` to `/tokens/${token.address}/posts`.
Re-test community terminal on desktop+mobile after endpoint fix to confirm real empty state/message rendering replaces 404 Not Found.
Keep agent-first flow unchanged: no report modal/no run-click-to-read behavior and settings-only financial controls are currently correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Public compute payload hygiene is correct: compute view omits prompt/system and exposes display_output/display_language for safe public rendering.
Archive migration integrity is correct for historical non-English runs: translation_original_hash equals sha256(original output) and output_en is present.
Community integration bug root cause is deterministic in code: `useData(`/posts?token=${token.address}`)` in HubOverview mismatches backend route contract.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (all requested core flows passed except Community terminal integration)

seed_data_creation: No seeded fake activity was created in canonical token DB. Exactly one real manual FARTCOIN run was triggered (run_id=0576f14ec8c0fdaecfc2903e6f217d69).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: default visible inline English report without modal click, removed legacy testids, one real run streamed inline and completed with queued/observe/research/proposal/completed activity kinds, BONK zero-balance Run research opens settings and does not create run, settings tabs/limits/topup/usage are modal-only, mobile 390x844 has zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth), Event radar and market panes are full-width on mobile, Community panel is visible (display:block) but currently shows Not Found due API path mismatch.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /token/9BB6... and inspect Community terminal; it displays Not Found. API proof: GET /api/posts?token=9BB6... returns 404, while GET /api/tokens/9BB6.../posts returns 200. RCA: frontend HubOverview uses incorrect endpoint for posts (`/posts?token=`) while backend route contract is token-scoped (`/tokens/{mint}/posts`). Mitigation: update frontend data hook path and re-run desktop/mobile community checks.
